en.joke: My phone battery percentage is the only thing more consistently low than my serotonin.
en.explanation: It's funny because it uses a common modern anxiety (low phone battery) as a deadpan metaphor for a common mental state (low serotonin).

people.name: Syd Howe
people.extract: Sydney Harris Howe was a Canadian professional ice hockey player. Howe played 17 seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Ottawa Senators, Philadelphia Quakers, Toronto Maple Leafs, St. Louis Eagles and Detroit Red Wings.
highlights: Played 17 seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL).
Played for Ottawa Senators, Toronto Maple Leafs, Detroit Red Wings.

people.name: Francis Parker Yockey
people.extract: Francis Parker Yockey was an American fascist writer best known for his neo-Spenglerian book Imperium: The Philosophy of History and Politics, published in 1948 under the pen name Ulick Varange, which called for a neo-Nazi European empire.
highlights: Best known for neo-Spenglerian book Imperium.
Imperium called for a neo-Nazi European empire.

people.name: Bob Bennett (politician)
people.extract: Robert Foster Bennett was an American politician and businessman who served as a United States senator from Utah from 1993 to 2011. A member of the Republican Party, Bennett held chairmanships and senior positions on various key Senate committees, including the Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs Committee; Appropriations Committee; Rules and Administration Committee; Energy and Natural Resources Committee; and Joint Economic Committee. Bennett spent his entire tenure in the Senate alongside Utah's senior senator, Orrin Hatch.
highlights: Chaired Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs Committee.
